name: facebookresearch_posediffusion/pose_diffusion/AGENT.python.tools.md

facebookresearch_posediffusion/pose_diff.run_demo: run the pose diffusion demo to predict camera poses from a folder of images
facebookresearch_posediffusion/pose_diff.extract_match: extract keypoint matches between images in a folder for geometry-guided sampling
facebookresearch_posediffusion/pose_diff.load_and_preprocess_images: load and preprocess images from a folder into tensors for the model
facebookresearch_posediffusion/pose_diff.geometry_guided_sampling: perform geometry-guided sampling using extracted keypoint matches to condition pose prediction
facebookresearch_posediffusion/pose_diff.compute_ARE: compute the absolute rotation error between predicted and ground truth camera rotations

facebookresearch_posediffusion/pose_diff.run_test_fn: run the test_fn to evaluate a pose diffusion model on Co3D dataset categories with Hydra config
facebookresearch_posediffusion/pose_diff.run_test_one_category: run _test_one_category to test the model on a single object category and collect rotation and translation errors
facebookresearch_posediffusion/pose_diff.run_prefix_with_module: run prefix_with_module to add a module. prefix to all keys in a PyTorch checkpoint state dict
facebookresearch_posediffusion/pose_diff.review_test_fn: review the test_fn function that orchestrates model evaluation across multiple categories with AUC and accuracy metrics
facebookresearch_posediffusion/pose_diff.review_test_one_category: review _test_one_category which loads sequences, extracts matches, runs inference, and computes camera alignment errors

facebookresearch_posediffusion/pose_diff.train_pose_diffusion_model: run the pose diffusion model training loop with Hydra config and HuggingFace Accelerator for multi-GPU support
facebookresearch_posediffusion/pose_diff.evaluate_camera_predictions: run evaluation on the pose diffusion model to compute rotation and translation accuracy metrics
facebookresearch_posediffusion/pose_diff.create_dynamic_batch_sampler: create a DynamicBatchSampler DataLoader that groups sequences by length for efficient batch processing
facebookresearch_posediffusion/pose_diff.compute_camera_accuracy_metrics: compute relative rotation and translation angle accuracy metrics including Racc, Tacc, and AUC scores
facebookresearch_posediffusion/pose_diff.resume_training_from_checkpoint: resume pose diffusion model training from a saved checkpoint with state dict loading
